# AI Development Instructions

This repository is a paper-only swing trading research system.

Requirements:

- Never generate code that places real trades.
- Never generate Robinhood execution code.
- Never create order execution, buy, sell, or brokerage API integrations.
- All outputs must be simulations, reports, CSV, JSON, or Markdown.
- Preserve paper_trade_mode=True.
- Prefer modular Python architecture with unit tests for every new module.
